kong-harnesses.message: **fleet:** let --claude-code-any-version take out one recorded bound beside a new bound on the other side
**fleet:** let --model move the pins in the Anthropic API mode
**logout:** add --auto-approve for sessions without a terminal
**profile:** ask whether Claude Code may send telemetry to Anthropic
**profile:** let auto mode run its check through the gateway
**clients:** make fast mode available behind the gateway

**fleet:** check every install path before the copy, and refuse one that is a link, a hard link, owned by another account or writable by other accounts, also through an ACL, and check it in a preinstall script of the macOS package
**fleet:** correct the --record help and the Windows executable path
**fleet:** find the Windows helper with wslpath in WSL, and name Windows interop when it is off

**fleet:** keep the recorded MCP choices on a rebuild, so a --record rebuild needs a recorded --mcp-servers mode other than allowlist again, and each server of the recorded allowlist again or the new --gateway-mcp-only, which takes out each entry the rebuild does not list again

**fleet:** keep the recorded models and version range on a rebuild, so a --record rebuild needs each recorded --model again or --profile-models, and each recorded bound again or --claude-code-any-version
**fleet:** keep the recorded policy on a rebuild, so a --record rebuild of a build with a policy needs --policy or --no-policy
**fleet:** keep the recorded WSL and host settings choices on a rebuild, so a --record rebuild of a --wsl inherit or --host-settings merge build needs --wsl or --host-settings again
**fleet:** make the administrator choose how MCP servers arrive, so a profile with gateway MCP servers now needs --mcp-servers exclusive, allowlist or any
**fleet:** make the install step name the build folder and paste as is, and leave the Linux build readable under a strict root umask
**fleet:** refuse a --policy that turns off the plugin that carries the gateway MCP servers, outside --mcp-servers exclusive
**fleet:** refuse a file build that leaves the policy choice open, so a --delivery file build now needs --policy or the new --no-policy
**fleet:** refuse a record a build could not have written, and a build whose record or files would be too large to read back
**fleet:** refuse a Windows policy that sets wslInheritsWindowsSettings without --wsl inherit
**fleet:** take a gateway MCP server out of managed-mcp.json only while it is the one the build wrote
**fleet:** write each allowlist address once, so a --mcp-url that repeats a gateway MCP server's address no longer makes the build's own record unreadable
**login:** name the cause when sign-in fails without a message
**login:** recover refused sign-ins, check OpenCode
**profile:** keep Claude Code off a proxy on a plain http gateway
**profile:** keep long labels on one line in profile create
